verdict.rationale: Gumloop's own docs say it supports connecting to any MCP server to extend agents with specialized tools. Enterprise Proxied MCPs connect existing external MCP servers through a managed proxy, and Hosted MCPs let organizations deploy custom MCP servers on Gumloop's infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually invoke tools from plugged-in MCP servers, and documented detail on supported transports and auth configuration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: This lets you extend your agents with specialized tools, internal services, or any MCP-compatible API.
Gumloop supports connecting to any Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
Proxied MCPs let you connect existing, external MCP servers to Gumloop through a managed proxy.
Hosted MCPs let your organization build and deploy custom MCP servers on Gumloop's infrastructure.
